declarations.name: ScriptDependentElement
declarations.description: Light-DOM readiness gate for a module and optional initialize(element, {signal}).

members.name: script
members.description: Required HTTP(S) module URL resolved against document.baseURI.

members.name: state
members.description: Current readiness state, reflected in data-script-dependent-state.

members.name: retry
members.description: Aborts the previous initializer and retries when connected; browser module caching still applies.

attributes.name: script
attributes.description: Required module URL. Changes hide content, abort initialization and start again.

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.description: Author initially. Component-owned during loading/error; removed on success unless the author hid previously ready content.

attributes.name: data-script-dependent-state
attributes.description: Component-owned output for styling, not configuration.

events.name: script-dependent:loading
events.description: Bubbling, composed event with authored detail.script when an attempt starts.

events.name: script-dependent:ready
events.description: Bubbling, composed event with resolved detail.script after evaluation and initialization succeed.

events.name: script-dependent:error
events.description: Bubbling, composed event with detail.script and detail.error when the current attempt fails; content stays hidden.

declarations.name: defineScriptDependent
declarations.description: Registers the class, or a subclass for a custom name, unless already defined. Import registers script-dependent. Browser-only module.
